about: Hand-written PROJECTS for the other AIs (owner rule 10, 2026-10-08: 'share workload with Grok; when it completes a task give it another; there should always be something for all other agents to work on'). Since 2026-10-09 most work is generated homework (tools/agents/homework.py from docs/agents/roles.json; docs/agents/RESEARCH_LOOP.md): this file keeps only what cannot be computed from the data (work in progress, code reviews, guides, music, motion, onboarding). A task with `reserves` holds those coins of those kinds for its AI while it is open. Each AI's page (docs/agents/QUEUE_{ai}.md, the same text as its Drive doc 'WORK QUEUE for ...') shows: finish first (state now), then its homework, then the other projects.

agents.name: Grok
agents.strength: Strongest outside contributor (Numista sweep 9/10, story fixes 10/10; best blind photo test so far): web + Drive access, opens Numista, careful sources.
agents.reach: Drive doc 'WORK QUEUE for Grok' in Titan Reliquary/ + this repo (raw GitHub URLs)

tasks.title: UI rethink, step 2: The Field's three filters, on the real data
tasks.what: Your Field prototype is live at https://jpavia10.github.io/titan-reliquary-preview/prototypes/v2/grok/ (scored 9; it ran first time on the current data). Build the three filters your proposal promises, in the same single file: (1) album: choosing an album family (../../../data/wants.json) shows its holes as empty rings in the rows; tapping a ring shows the want-list entry with its price and source; (2) metal: silver and gold light up, the rest dims; (3) to photograph: the coins without a phone photo rise. Then measure ?fps for open, back and drag the same way as before. Same hard rules (live data only, 16 px, 44 px, Motion Full/Calm/Off, pause when hidden). Send design_grok_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}_field-v2.html plus a short .md of what changed to Drive 'design-incoming (AI UI proposals)'.
tasks.done_when: Claude replaces /prototypes/v2/grok/ with v2 and Joseph tries 'find a missing Silver Eagle' on his phone.

tasks.title: Fact-check the coin stories, C151 to C283
tasks.what: Your first 18 fixes (C161 to C262, changes_grok-bot_20261008-1101/1102/1103) are merged: every one checked out. Carry on through C283 the same way: check each story against its own record and the cited Numista entry; where a claim is wrong, send a corrected story (source = the exact entry; say what was wrong; change only the wrong sentence). (While this is open, nobody else is given these stories: they are reserved for you.)
tasks.done_when: Every story from C151 to C283 checked; a list of the ones you changed and why (in your FEEDBACK doc note).

tasks.title: Album prices: a second source for the 10 most expensive holes
tasks.what: Your A001-A016 list is live as 'Cost to complete' (collection/prices/wants_values_grok_20261010-1949.json). The key dates look low against dealer guides (1921-D dime $140 at VF, where APMEX's lowest grade starts near $158). For the 10 most expensive holes in that file (A006 1916-D, 1921-D, 1921, 1923-S, 1926-S, 1927-D, 1916-S, 1918-D; A012 1949-D; A007 1964-D), find a second price page (PCGS CoinFacts, NGC Price Guide, Greysheet retail or APMEX) for the same grade, and send wants_values_grok_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json with the same shape; where the two sources differ by more than 25 %, give the higher and name both in source.
tasks.done_when: One file in reviews-incoming; Claude checks a sample and the app's total updates.

tasks.title: Music: a recording for each of the 3 held pieces
tasks.what: Held in docs/music/wanted.json: Elgar Nimrod, Debussy Rêverie (only a saxophone arrangement found so far), Satie Gymnopédie 3 on piano (the search keeps finding No. 1). Handel's Largo is done: Lea Desandre with Les Arts Florissants (CC BY 3.0) is live since 2026-10-09. For each held piece, find one Wikimedia Commons file that is a real performance of exactly that piece (not a synth or MIDI render), public domain or CC BY / CC BY-SA, with the performer named; give the exact Commons file title, the license and the performer, the same way as your 2026-10-08 music check. Save it as music_grok_{YYYYMMDD-HHMM}.json in Drive 'music-requests'.
tasks.done_when: One JSON file with an exact Commons title (or 'none found' and why) for each held piece.
